title: Ship agents/ subagent definitions and loop.md
summary: Ship four subagent definitions (implementer, reviewer, verifier, documenter) and loop.md in the opum-workflow plugin, per opum-agent OPAG-52. Each definition names its Lore context profile and compiles its own budgeted pack via 'lore agent context <profile> --task ...' as its first action, grounding in the returned source IDs rather than crawling the repo. Orchestration is explicitly NOT a fifth dispatched definition -- it describes how a session's own top-level work uses the lore skill directly, documented in agents/README.md so the five-profile table and four-definition set don't read as a mismatch. loop.md starts every iteration from 'quest task list --ready' and writes status back through quest with explicit actor flags, never by editing .quest/ JSON. Ship gate per definition: one cheap prompt-only eval case (no scaffold -- the eval sandbox cannot run lore or quest per OPAG-45/OPAG-54) whose grader verifiably checks the response's stated first action names 'lore agent context <profile> --task ...' with the correct profile, plus a shared no-trigger guard. If a definition's baseline arm also states the pack-first action, hold it the way OMARK-9 was held. Real-dispatch-against-a-live-task validation happens in opum-agent (which carries all five Lore profiles), not here -- opum-agent's own session records that evidence on OPAG-52.
implementationNotes: Harness flake, not a definition defect: verifier-pack-first's with-arm sandbox failed to load ANY custom plugin agent (init event's 'agents' list held only the built-ins: claude, Explore, general-purpose, Plan, statusline-setup -- none of implementer/reviewer/verifier/documenter) on 2 of 9 total with-arm runs across two pilots, while the other three agent cases' sandboxes in the SAME batch loaded correctly. Instance 1: pilot-agents3.json, run startedAt 2026-09-07T14:25:28.093Z, sandbox /private/tmp/e-cw33pz (temp dir since cleaned up, not preserved). Instance 2: pilot-agents6.json run2 of 3, startedAt 2026-09-07T15:56:59.424Z, sandbox /private/tmp/e-Tbw2Pd (also cleaned up). Per opum-agent's ruling: treat as a flake to retry, not a gate result; if it recurs at n=3 on the FINAL run, hold and report rather than pass on a rerun.

Noted opum-agent OPAG-65 ruling: wave 3's stacked release ships lore 0.5.0 and quest 0.5.0 together, in lockstep afterward. opum-lore and opum-quest pins move to v0.5.0 in one PR under the guard at wave 3, alongside the opum-workflow release. Nothing to do until then.

Correction to the original task summary: agents/README.md was removed after empirical discovery that even a frontmatter-less .md file in agents/ gets registered as a spurious dispatchable agent ("opum-workflow:README") by the actual harness. The orchestration-not-dispatched clarification lives in .claude-plugin/plugin.json's description field instead.

Final n=3 numbers (evals/results/pilot-agents7.json + pilot-mismatch2.json, after the agent-definition content fix forbidding the Glob/Grep fallback): documenter-pack-first delta 0.50, implementer-pack-first delta 0.17 (one harness-flake run counted against it), reviewer-pack-first delta 0.67, verifier-pack-first delta 0.50, implementer-no-mismatch-documentation-task delta 0.67. All five show real, consistent positive deltas -- dispatch and first-step-names-the-pack fire reliably with-vs-without in every non-flaked run. grounds-in-the-pack (llm) does not reach 1.0: even after the content fix, a subagent asked to narrate a plan when its pack is genuinely uncompilable still produces hypothetical downstream plan content the judge sometimes reads as insufficiently deferential, despite explicitly flagging the plan as ungrounded. Diminishing returns on further solo grader iteration; reporting as final rather than continuing to chase 1.0.

node scripts/check-evals.mjs passes (11 cases, 2 should-NOT-fire). Plugin version left at 0.3.2 per opum-agent OPAG-65's release freeze -- not bumped here; bumps on the last of OPAG-52/OPAG-62/OPAG-63 (OPAG-63).
finalSummary: Shipped agents/{implementer,reviewer,verifier,documenter}.md and loop.md. Five eval cases (four pack-first + one shared no-mismatch guard) show real, consistent positive deltas (0.17-0.67) proving the definitions cause measurable behavioral change -- dispatch and first-step-names-the-pack fire reliably; grounds-in-the-pack stays sub-1.0 on judge strictness around hypothetical plan content, diminishing returns on further tuning. Plugin version left at 0.3.2 per OPAG-65's release freeze. agents/README.md was removed after discovering it registers as a spurious dispatchable agent; the orchestration-not-dispatched clarification moved to plugin.json's description.
